disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at four across the three units

subject: gov.protect
name: NCRA-SLRSA register-to-register data-sharing agreement
what_would_settle_it: The signed agreement or a published summary stating what data classes flow, on what legal basis and with what retention limit.
disposition: probed 2026-08-09: the agreement exists - NCRA's own news index records a Data Sharing Agreement with the SLRSA, and a 2023-10-27 newspaper account of the signing states the SLRSA was granted authorised access to NCRA's identity verification platform for vehicle registration and driving licences. The instrument itself is not published, so the data classes, legal basis and retention limit remain unestablished.

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Legal basis for data sharing between government registers
what_would_settle_it: A data-sharing instrument, regulation or protocol governing exchanges between the identity register and other agencies.
disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at four across the three units

subject: dpi.pay
name: Bank of Sierra Leone RTGS and ACH re-platforming
what_would_settle_it: An award notice from the Bank of Sierra Leone or the National Public Procurement Authority for references 8922483/8922484, naming supplier, value and scope. The only listing found was an inadmissible-origin tender aggregator, retired 2026-08-10; neither contracting authority's procurement page carries a matching entry.

subject: dpi.mis
name: Court case management system
what_would_settle_it: A judiciary or Justice Sector Coordination Office record of a deployed case management system, or a procurement award for one.
disposition: the 2024-2030 sector strategy records no operating system; settled by the strategy itself as a searched absence
